scope: Independent archive decoding and direct NumPy aggregation from all60 final checkpoints; no producer reducer, kernel or model imports. Every selected count and final v/s/h value compared; all34 cohort metrics and408 matched contrasts recomputed.
limits: These are post-hoc coarse windows from existing trials, not new simulation or biological replicates.
Counts cannot locate a transmission bottleneck, infer latency/depression or prove the proposed anatomical route carried activity.
Side/column metadata remain uncalibrated; no wind, hunger, reflection, clamp, body or bump behavior is tested.
Per-window finite counts have boundary quantization; 454.545Hz is the long-run22tick refractory ceiling for non-source cells, not an exact finite-window maximum.
